description: Argentina's Undersecretariat of Water Resources produced the National Water Information System, which publishes the consolidated historical data and the raw near real-time sensor data of the stations in the National Hydrological Network, a statistical network. Coverage is Argentina. The data are free to view per station online under the site's terms, and neither the Undersecretariat nor the member bodies take responsibility for how they are used. Caveats: the real-time values are unvalidated raw sensor records, and the site states that it is not a flood or hydrometeorological alert network. Simulation uses: historical level and discharge series for flood frequency and drought analysis. Related records: Brazil's HidroWeb (data-brazil-ana-hidroweb-hydrometeorological-network).
